lpc-base-assets.name: Liberated Pixel Cup (LPC) base assets
lpc-base-assets.note: The original LPC monster walking sprites.

lpc-monsters.name: [LPC] Monsters
lpc-monsters.note: Four-direction attack animations for the ten LPC monsters.

lpc-monster-death.name: [LPC] Monster Death Animations
lpc-monster-death.note: Generated by pvigier's falling-pixels script; each sheet repeats the base rows on top and appends two rows holding a single six-frame death animation.

lpc-animals.name: [LPC] bears, deer, lions and more
lpc-animals.note: Bear, deer and lion sheets are 5 columns wide: the fifth column only exists for the left/right views, the rest of the sheet is padded with a magenta sentinel.

reemax-birds.name: LPC Raven and Seagull
reemax-birds.note: One sheet holds both birds: columns 0-2 are the seagull (light grey body, black wingtips, pale yellow beak), columns 3-5 the raven (all black).

cats-rework.name: Cats Rework
cats-rework.note: Rework of bluecarrot16's [LPC] Cats and Dogs.

creatures.name: Slime Projectile
creatures.notes: Single-direction 4-frame fly/pop effect; ignore the direction buttons.

creatures.name: Bear
creatures.notes: Left/right walk has five frames; up/down has four. Attack rows are three or four frames depending on the view. This sheet's rows are ordered up, right, left, down.

creatures.name: Deer
creatures.notes: Rows are ordered up, left, right, down. The left/right views are the same way round as the lion sheet, and the opposite way round from the fox and shiba sheets in the same pack.

creatures.name: Fox
creatures.notes: Rows are ordered down, right, left, up; the left/right views are the opposite way round from the deer and shiba sheets in the same pack.

creatures.name: Lion
creatures.notes: Rows are ordered up, left, right, down. The pack notes that the lioness' face is a little off in the east/west views.

creatures.name: Shark
creatures.notes: Columns 0-3 are the four-frame swim cycle, columns 4-6 the three-frame submerge/dive. Each row is one direction.

creatures.name: Chicken
creatures.notes: The eat animation is a chew that plays forward then back; it is stored here as an explicit ping-pong frame list.

creatures.name: Cow
creatures.notes: The eat animation is a chew that plays forward then back; it is stored here as an explicit ping-pong frame list.

creatures.name: Llama
creatures.notes: The eat animation is a chew that plays forward then back; it is stored here as an explicit ping-pong frame list.

creatures.name: Pig
creatures.notes: The eat animation is a chew that plays forward then back; it is stored here as an explicit ping-pong frame list.

creatures.name: Sheep
creatures.notes: The eat animation is a chew that plays forward then back; it is stored here as an explicit ping-pong frame list.

creatures.name: Cat
creatures.notes: Three-frame cycle; the middle frame is the standing pose used for idle.

creatures.name: Rabbit
creatures.notes: Rows 0-3 are the bound/hop cycle, rows 4-7 the calmer walk.

creatures.name: Beetle
creatures.notes: The beetle's front and back views are near mirror images, so the row order was pinned down from the pack's own description of the north view. Rows are ordered down, up, right, left.

creatures.name: Wild Boar
creatures.notes: Walk, attack and die come from three separate sheets. The pack also ships modular armour and a barrel layer set that this creator does not expose yet.

creatures.name: Horse
creatures.notes: Walk and gallop each have their own sheet per coat colour; the pack's idle sheets are a single row so idle uses the first walk frame. Saddle, blanket, mask, mane/tail, horn and sock layers exist in the pack but are not exposed yet.
